dd0fb1487df30cfb020118b857acfc4d.overview: The queen of mythical Sylvania marries a courtier, who finds his new life unsatisfying
dd0fb1487df30cfb020118b857acfc4d.tagline: He sang himself into the Queen's boudoir! One kiss and the whole kingdom was his!

dd1f406643f19e7d45776c76ff0dec5b.overview: Tensions run high when a crazed bomber rigs a Los Angeles bus with a device that will kill everyone on board if the vehicle's speed dips below fifty miles per hour.

dd389a22ba4ccc3828b7036d134c3f74.overview: After his father's death, a young boy finds solace in action movies featuring an indestructible cop. Given a magic ticket by a theater manager, he is transported into the film and teams up with the cop to stop a villain who escapes into the real world.

dd51f1ceccdd19988dad14e5d9e69d00.overview: When French criminal Corey gets released from prison, he resolves to never return. He is quickly pulled back into the underworld, however, after a chance encounter with escaped murderer Vogel. Along with former policeman and current alcoholic Jansen, they plot an intricate jewel heist. All the while, quirky Police Commissioner Mattei, who was the one to lose custody of Vogel, is determined to find him.
dd51f1ceccdd19988dad14e5d9e69d00.tagline: No place to hide . . . nowhere to run . . .

dd6aeca5d8390e8b12925593ca325bba.overview: A Catholic New Yorker falls in love with a girl and wants to marry her, but he struggles to accept her past and what it means for their future.
dd6aeca5d8390e8b12925593ca325bba.tagline: Mean Streets was just around the corner.

dd6fe6d18ec331e6baa0c560ef04d81e.overview: An insurance representative is seduced by a dissatisfied housewife into a scheme of insurance fraud and murder that arouses the suspicion of his colleague, a claims investigator.
dd6fe6d18ec331e6baa0c560ef04d81e.tagline: It's love and murder at first sight!

dd91a24ae0ab6ff2848200b275501537.overview: In the Sengoku period, a woman and her daughter are raped and murdered by soldiers during a time of civil war. Afterwards, a series of samurai returning from the war through that area are found mysteriously dead with their throats torn out. The governor calls in a wild and fierce young hero to quell what is evidently an Onryō ghost.
dd91a24ae0ab6ff2848200b275501537.tagline: Beware what lurks in the bamboo forest craving the blood of samurai!

dd93824b2836e3313e783d1861cb90ab.overview: A mild-mannered professor moonlighting as a fake hit man in police stings ignites a chain reaction of trouble when he falls for a potential client.
dd93824b2836e3313e783d1861cb90ab.tagline: He's not a killer, but he can pretend.

ddab14f212860e51ca74c1c78adf4965.overview: An electrifying glimpse into the complex life and thrilling, unparalleled performances of rock and roll's first and wildest practitioner: Jerry Lee Lewis.

ddaf93a77732e627705c99359a913f8d.overview: Mr. Hulot is the head designer of the Altra Automotive Co. His latest invention is a newfangled camper car loaded with outrageous extra features. Along with the company's manager and publicity model, Hulot sets out from Paris with the intention of debuting the car at the annual auto show in Amsterdam. The going isn't easy, however, and the group encounters an increasingly bizarre series of hurdles and setbacks en route.
ddaf93a77732e627705c99359a913f8d.tagline: The laughs are bumper to bumper!

ddbabc49d0dd18c7dd4e9e8b2872b6b0.overview: Jill Tyrell is a narcissistic sociopath who manages a beauty parlour alongside her moronic, asthmatic assistant Linda. When Jill learns that her husband has cancer, she uses this fact to manipulate new neighbour Cathy Cole, a wheelchair user with multiple sclerosis whose husband Don, a womanising doctor, Jill has become obsessed with.

ddbce7a2ac06329976dd578f56b413dc.overview: A nameless ronin, or samurai with no master, enters a small village in feudal Japan where two rival businessmen are struggling for control of the local gambling trade. Taking the name Sanjuro Kuwabatake, the ronin convinces both silk merchant Tazaemon and sake merchant Tokuemon to hire him as a personal bodyguard, then artfully sets in motion a full-scale gang war between the two ambitious and unscrupulous men.
ddbce7a2ac06329976dd578f56b413dc.tagline: Kill one or a hundred... you only hang once

ddf07105733ba0687ff3b2109d5be9f2.overview: When Konstadinos misses a flight and returns home unexpectedly, he finds his wife in bed with his best friend. Shocked, he leaves the house without letting them know what he saw and begins wandering in the streets of Athens.
